All skills / Shopify store owners

Agent Skills for Shopify store owners

Skills for the weekly jobs of running a Shopify store: product copy, SEO fields, support replies, chargebacks, Black Friday and how AI shopping agents read your store. Give your assistant a store or product URL, or paste text, and get work you can paste into Shopify.

12 skills: 6 paid and 6 free, plus 1 pack.

Free and paid

Start with a free skill. The paid ones each do a different job.

SkillPriceYou give itYou get
Agent-Ready Quick CheckFreeYour store URL.A 6-check scorecard of how well AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) can read your store. Each check is compared with 99 Shopify stores we audited in October 2026.
Alt Text WriterFreeYour store URL, a product URL, or your product export CSV.Alt text for every product image, written while looking at the photo. Comes as a Shopify import CSV, a review sheet, and a paste-by-hand list for products with variant images.
Chargeback Evidence ChecklistFreeThe dispute reason.The evidence to gather for that reason, what you already have, and where to find each piece in Shopify.
Agent-Ready Store Audit$5Your store URL.A score out of 100 for how well AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and others) can find, understand and buy from your store, an agent's-eye test of real buyer questions, and a ranked fix list.
BFCM Campaign Kit$5Your store URL (plus your margin, if you know it).A Black Friday / Cyber Monday plan: offer maths on your real prices, a dated US/UK calendar, 5 emails, 3 SMS, banners and an ops checklist. No fake urgency.
Chargeback Response Writer$5The dispute details plus the evidence you actually have.A response matched to the reason code, a checklist of what to attach, and a list of gaps. It never invents evidence, and it tells you when accepting is cheaper.
Product Description Rewriter$5A product URL, pasted text, a collection, or your product export CSV.Clean Shopify HTML descriptions with an SEO title (≤ 60 characters) and meta description (≤ 155). Bulk runs produce an import CSV.
Product SEO Fixer$5A product URL, a collection URL, or your product export CSV.A prioritised SEO fix list with the exact text to paste and where. Collection mode also writes the collection intro and SEO fields; CSV mode returns a re-importable CSV.
Support Macro Writer$5Your store URL.It reads your real refund and shipping policies and writes ready-to-import support replies, starting with the hard cases: stuck in transit, "delivered" but not received, address changes, cancellations.
